raw_sections.skills:
Core Competencies: Fund Accounting, NAV validation, Trade Booking & Validation, Swift Processing, ETD Products, Corporate Action Processing, Cash & Position Reconciliation, Bloomberg, Mutual Funds.
JP Morgan, March 2022 to October 2025, Team lead
➢ Fund Services (Trade capture and Validation)
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Booking and Monitoring trades across multiple financial products including MBS, FX, Securities and Money Market instruments, strictly adhering to Client instructions to ensure flawless execution.
Processing trades via SWIFT messages and trade blotter instructions, ensuring accuracy and alignment with operational standards across global regions.
Conducting Proactive checks on failed and missing trades and take corrective actions promptly to minimize financial risk and maintain data integrity.
Resolving trade breaks on timely manner and escalate unresolved issues as needed to ensure Swift resolution.
Consistently meeting daily deliverables with a strong focus on precision and adherence to cut-off times, contributing to high client satisfaction and process reliability.
Addressing Client queries and executing trade bookings before regional cut-offs, maintaining service level agreements and operational excellence.
Ensure 100% accuracy & timeliness across trade lifecycle activities by effectively utilizing using VET & CSW tools, strengthening process integrity and client satisfaction.
Resolving High-Impact trade discrepancies and operational challenges, reducing turnaround time and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability within the team.
Societe Generale, October 2020 to October 2021, Analyst
➢ Trade processing Management
Key Roles and Responsibilities

Initiate Account opening request with custody and make sure the accounts are opened on a timely manner.
Booking trades as per Fund Managers instructions and confirmation of trades as per custody Contract note.
Monitoring settlement of trades and ensure settlement takes place on time. • Take voting on corporate action annual general meeting from Fund managers. • Processing Prime brokers data management as a part of daily NAV valuation. • Performing controls on Subscription and Redemption of Hedge/ Mutual funds and analysis of cash flow, cash balances of all the funds.
Drafting legal confirmation concerning OTC operations and certain kinds of funds. • Working close relationship with Prime brokers, Fund Managers, Custodians and other Counterparties.
Escalate relevant and critical issues to management and all necessary stake holders in a timely manner.
Ensure to investigate and clear all the Stock and Cash breaks on the Funds.
raw_sections.experience:
State Street Corporation, April 2018 to July 2020, Associate
➢ Fund Accounting (NAV Validation)
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Authenticate and review all daily operations in NAV. • Responsible for Handling NAV Reconciliation of Daily, weekly and monthly Funds. • Reconcile capstock, income and expense accruals are in line. • Reconcile the trades and corporate actions processed on the funds. • Monitor the pricing on the funds and checking the exceptions through Bloomberg. • Reconcile Cash & position breaks on the funds and resolve on timely manner. • Ensure to check whether the performance fees applicable on the funds. • Making necessary checks and calculation of Dividend Income. • Handling the additional work provided by the client and ensure proper review with quality deliverables is sent in a timely manner.
Calculation of market value, futures, income accruals, dividend and expense impacts on the fund.
Keen knowledge of current alternative procedures and process. • Support training of new hires as necessary. • Contribution to make process go live within 6 months. • To manage daily coverage allocation of team members and ensure all the tasks assigned by the team are completed.
Suggesting new ideas and escalating the unresolved problems faced in day to day services.
